reason: Visible facts support eligibility: user gave user id and reservation id, stated reason is health, booking was created 2024-05-01 for a 2024-05-22 trip (within 24 hours of booking is false), no portion has flown, cabin is economy not basic economy, insurance is no, and the policy allows cancellation for business flights or covered insurance but also allows if booked within 24 hours—none are shown.
